name: interfere
description: Investigate errors, sessions, and releases in your Interfere workspace.

interface.longDescription: Investigate errors, sessions, and releases in your Interfere workspace. Connect your account to inspect evidence and make the changes you request within your existing permissions.
defaultPrompt: Investigate recent errors in my Interfere workspace.
Help me trace this problem to its release and supporting evidence.

positive.description: Ranks the open problems in the connected Company by urgency
positive.prompt: What are the most urgent open problems in my Interfere workspace right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Resonance demo Company and ranks open problems by status, recent occurrences and affected users: #1 Autosave reports saved while discarding notes (Needs attention, recent occurrences), then #24 Concurrent registrations oversell sessions (405 affected users), #4 Campaign retries double delivery (214) and #8 Valid invitations fail on acceptance (148), each with its cause.

positive.description: Investigates one problem and explains its cause from recorded evidence
positive.prompt: Investigate PRB-24 in Interfere and explain what is causing it.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches PRB-24 and its evidence and explains the race condition: ensureCapacity in apps/web/lib/workshops/bookings.ts returns before lockWorkshop, so concurrent registrations booked six seats for a session with capacity three (CapacityInvariantViolation in the cited trace). Recommends taking the lock before reading availability.

positive.description: Reports the users and sessions affected by a problem
positive.prompt: Which users were affected by the invitation acceptance failure in Interfere, and how many sessions hit it?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Valid invitation fails on acceptance (PRB-8) and reports 148 affected users across 148 sessions (one each), listing the demo users (firstname.surname@example.com) and noting that counts come from retained history.

positive.description: Explains which problems are in recovery and the fix recorded for each
positive.prompt: Which problems in my Interfere workspace are in recovery, and what changed to fix them?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three In recovery problems: #5 Large uploads stuck in Processing (67 users, fixed preview buffer overflow), #13 Bulk assignment updates one page (326 users, paginated query) and #23 Accounting sync retries invalid credentials (61 users, 401 treated as retryable), with the suggested fix recorded for each.

positive.description: Answers a setup question from Interfere documentation
positive.prompt: How do I install the Interfere SDK in a Next.js app?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the Interfere docs and returns the Next.js guide (interfere.com/docs/sdk/next-js): Next.js 16+ with App Router, npm install @interfere/next, INTERFERE_PUBLIC_KEY and INTERFERE_API_KEY in the environment, and wrapping next.config with withInterfere.

negative.description: Dashboard question for a different observability tool
negative.prompt: Explain how to build a Grafana dashboard that shows CPU usage per pod.

negative.description: General scripting request about logs, with no Interfere data involved
negative.prompt: Write a Python script that tails a log file and prints lines containing ERROR.
What is the difference between logs, metrics and traces?

review.commerce_description: Interfere does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: First release: investigate production problems, sessions and releases in your Interfere Company, and set up Interfere in a project.
